newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates rise, one-week narrows.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates rise, one-week narrows.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose on Sunday in a short private sector market to between 10-1/4 and 10-3/8 percent from Thursday's range of 9-3/4 and 10-1/4 percent, bankers said.
One-week rates narrowed to between 10-5/16 to 10-3/8 percent from 9-7/8 and 10-3/8 percent on Thursday, they added.
The market is usually short on Sundays, the beginning of the banking week. Some bankers said they dealt at 10-1/2 percent.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
